headline: Allentown City Council approves 1.5-mill property tax increase in 5-2 vote
summary: The Allentown City Council voted 5-2 Tuesday night to approve a 1.5-mill property tax increase, the first in four years. The increase will fund additional police hiring and road resurfacing. Council members Garcia and Thompson voted against, arguing for spending cuts instead.

headline: Bethlehem Steel site redevelopment wins $12M state grant for mixed-use project
summary: The former Bethlehem Steel site along the Lehigh River has been awarded a $12 million state grant for a mixed-use redevelopment project. The project will include 200 residential units, retail space, and a public riverwalk. Construction is expected to begin in fall 2026.

headline: Easton Farmers Market opens for 2026 season this Saturday
summary: The Easton Farmers Market, the oldest continuous open-air market in the nation, opens its 2026 season Saturday. Over 40 vendors will offer produce, baked goods, and artisan items at Centre Square from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.

headline: AP: National housing starts rise 3.2% in February
summary: Housing starts across the United States rose 3.2 percent in February, the Commerce Department reported Thursday. The increase was driven by single-family construction in the South and West regions.

headline: MacArthur Road in Whitehall Township to close for water main replacement
summary: A section of MacArthur Road in Whitehall Township will be closed starting Monday for emergency water main replacement. The closure between Grape Street and Lehigh Street is expected to last two weeks. Detours will be posted.

headline: Nazareth Area School Board approves preliminary 2026-27 budget with 2.8% tax increase
summary: The Nazareth Area School Board approved a preliminary 2026-27 budget that includes a 2.8 percent property tax increase. Superintendent Davis said the increase is needed to cover rising pension costs and special education mandates.
